title: RxJava restores discarded group demand and respects the survivor’s limit
summary: Cancelling the stalled group now delivers 4 through 8 and completes the survivor and outer stream. With one unit of demand the survivor waited for its next four requests.

change.description: A group cancelled with unread items now initiates the drain that credits those items toward upstream requests.

notes: Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
